channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Voices: How Utah law enforcement can avoid politics and provide leadership on immigration enforcement
item.description: How should Utah law enforcement handle immigration? In an op-ed for The Salt Lake Tribune, former Salt Lake County Sheriff James Winder offers four steps to help local sheriffs and chiefs “avoid politics and provide leadership.”

item.title: Letter: We cannot vote for the same people (or the same party) and expect meaningful change
item.description: Letter: The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over and expecting a different result. If we continue to vote Republicans into office, we Utahns have lost our minds.

item.title: Letter: America is drifting away from being a nation defined by rights
item.description: Letter: When belonging becomes something that must be demonstrated rather than assumed, the meaning of citizenship becomes conditional. That should alarm us all.

item.title: Letter: Utah bill targeting protesters is a frontal assault on First Amendment rights
item.description: Letter: HB331 is a direct attack on our First Amendment rights, and Utahns must contact their representatives immediately to speak against it.

item.title: Once on the brink of closing, this iconic Utah music venue reaches an impressive milestone
item.description: Corey Fox helped catapult bands like Imagine Dragons and Neon Trees into stardom at his 300-capacity Utah music venue.

item.title: From gold medals to proposals: Utah athletes steal the show at 2026 Winter Games
item.description: From backward skiing to presidential criticism, Utah Olympic athletes gave us these moments to remember at the 2026 Milan-Cortina Olympic Games.

item.title: One of Utah’s highest-profile murder trials begins Monday. Here’s what you should know.
item.description: One of Utah’s most-watched murder cases heads to trial this week, drawing attention from national news outlets and true crime podcasters.

item.title: Big Cottonwood Canyon avalanche leaves 2 men hospitalized after other skiers ‘immediately’ helped rescue them
item.description: The eight nearby skiers helped pull the men from the snow before they were taken to a Salt Lake Valley hospital.

item.title: LDS garment history: The emphasis changed under Brigham Young
item.description: Authors discuss the history of LDS temple garments, including the fact that sleeveless ones were proposed nearly a hundred years ago.

item.title: A Salt Lake City hotel is closing and laying off 100 workers after it sold its property to a university
item.description: The Sheraton, which is owned by Marriott, disclosed the cuts in a WARN notice filed with the state.
